Package org.thewhitemage13.handler

Class OrderCreateHandler

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.handler.OrderCreateHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.thewhitemage13.interfaces.OrderCreateEventHandlerInterface
@Component @KafkaListener(topics="order.created") public class OrderCreateHandler extends Object implements org.thewhitemage13.interfaces.OrderCreateEventHandlerInterface
Handles the OrderCreatedEvent and updates the stock accordingly.

This component listens to the "order.created" Kafka topic and processes the event to update product quantities. If the product's stock falls below a threshold, a "low.stock" event is sent to notify about low inventory.

Key Features:

  • Processes OrderCreatedEvent by updating the product quantity in the database.
  • Publishes ProductCreateEvent to the "low.stock" Kafka topic when stock is low.
  • Handles ProductNotFoundException in case the product is not found in the repository.

Usage:

This handler is automatically triggered when an OrderCreatedEvent is published to the "order.created" Kafka topic. The handler updates the product stock and sends relevant events based on stock conditions.

    • create

      @KafkaHandler public void create(org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderCreatedEvent)
      Handles an OrderCreatedEvent by updating the corresponding product's quantity.

      The handler decreases the product's quantity based on the order's count of items. If the stock falls below 100, it sends a ProductCreateEvent to the "low.stock" Kafka topic. It also ensures the updated product is saved in the repository.
